cnn.label: not_planet
cnn.note: deep-learning multimodal verdict — cross-mission model (trained on Kepler + TESS), held-out AUC ~0.95.

diagnostics.label: Transit shape (U vs V)
diagnostics.tests: Planets carve a flat-bottomed U-dip; grazing binaries make a sharp V.
diagnostics.result: V-shaped — more like two stars grazing.

diagnostics.label: Secondary eclipse
diagnostics.tests: A second dip half an orbit later means the companion glows — a star, not a planet.
diagnostics.result: No secondary dip — consistent with a dark planet.

diagnostics.label: Odd vs even depth
diagnostics.tests: If alternating dips differ in depth, it's likely a binary caught at half its true period.
diagnostics.result: Odd and even dips match — one repeating event.

diagnostics.label: Centroid / blend
diagnostics.tests: If the star's light-centre shifts during the dip, the signal comes from a different nearby star.
diagnostics.result: Light-centre stays put — the signal is from this star.
